name: plamocast
title: Plamocast
description: Japanese ⇄ English translation with local PLaMo 3 Translate (auto-detected), any OpenAI-compatible LLM, or DeepL
author: ginga

commands.name: index
commands.title: Translate
commands.subtitle: Plamocast
commands.description: Translate text between Japanese and English with live preview

commands.name: choose-model
commands.title: Choose Model
commands.subtitle: Plamocast
commands.description: Pick the translation model from local servers (LM Studio, Ollama), a custom server, or DeepL

commands.name: translate-auto
commands.title: Translate Auto (JA ⇄ EN)
commands.subtitle: Plamocast
commands.description: Detect the language of the selected text and translate Japanese → English or English → Japanese

commands.name: translate-to-japanese
commands.title: Translate into Japanese
commands.subtitle: Plamocast
commands.description: Translate the selected text into Japanese

commands.name: translate-to-english
commands.title: Translate into English
commands.subtitle: Plamocast
commands.description: Translate the selected text into English

preferences.name: customEndpoint
preferences.title: Custom Server: Endpoint
preferences.description: Extra OpenAI-compatible server to list in Choose Model (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, or a server on another machine). LM Studio (localhost:1234) and Ollama (localhost:11434) are detected automatically.

preferences.name: customApiKey
preferences.title: Custom Server: API Key
preferences.description: Sent as a Bearer token to the custom server only

preferences.name: deeplApiKey
preferences.title: DeepL: API Key
preferences.description: Enables DeepL in Choose Model (Free keys end with :fx)

preferences.name: llmPrompt
preferences.title: LLM: System Prompt
preferences.description: Optional custom system prompt for general LLMs (not PLaMo). {{target}} becomes Japanese/English, {{style}} the Japanese style instruction. Empty uses the built-in prompt.

preferences.name: source
preferences.title: Preferred Source
preferences.description: Where to read the text from. Falls back to the other source when empty.

preferences.name: onTranslateAction
preferences.title: On Translation Action
preferences.description: What the quick (no-view) commands do with the translation
